sections.heading: Electropolished Tube Buyers in Alwar: Dairy, Food Parks and Highway Industry
paragraphs: Northern Alwar is about two hours from Delhi along the old National Highway 8 (now NH-48), and the Rajasthan government accelerated industrial estate development along that highway from the 2000s, including the Neemrana estate dedicated to Japanese companies. That engineering base matters for us mainly through the fabricators and OEMs who build process equipment for food and dairy customers.

For hygienic tube specifically, Alwar's growth story is dairy. Union Home and Cooperation Minister Amit Shah performed the bhoomi pujan for a 3 lakh-litre-a-day milk processing plant in Alwar and said its capacity would soon be increased to 5 lakh litres. The district's milk union, the Alwar Dugdh Sangh, has grown from 500 litres to about 1.5 lakh litres a day of milk collection over 50 years. On the food side, RIICO has operated an agro food park in Alwar district since 2006-07, according to the state's agriculture marketing minister.

sections.heading: What a 3-Lakh-Litre Dairy Needs in Stainless Steel
paragraphs: A new dairy at that scale runs raw-milk reception, chilling, separation, pasteurisation, and product lines for curd, buttermilk, paneer and ghee, with CIP cleaning several times a day. Product-contact tube is normally 304 or 304L to ASTM A270, with 316L on salted product, whey and hot caustic CIP supply where chlorides and temperature work together against 304.

Electropolishing is worth specifying where residue is the risk: cultured-product lines, cream and flavoured milk, and the CIP return legs that show whether a circuit is really clean. Raw-milk reception and utility lines rarely justify it. Whatever the finish, slope and drainability decide hygiene: a line that holds milk after draining is a risk however smooth its bore.

sections.heading: Equipment Builders Supplying Alwar's Dairy and Food Projects
paragraphs: Large dairy projects are usually executed by turnkey contractors and skid builders who buy tube in bulk and need it cut, documented and delivered to their fabrication shop or straight to site. If you are building tanks, pasteuriser skids or CIP stations for an Alwar plant, tell us the end user's piping specification at enquiry so the certificates we issue match what their validation team will ask for.

sections.heading: RFQ Checklist for Dairy Tube Delivered to Alwar
bullets: Section of the plant (reception, pasteurisation, cultured products, CIP supply or return) so we can recommend 304L, 316L and SF1 or SF4 for each.
Sizes as OD × wall, typically 25.4 mm to 101.6 mm OD in 1.65 mm wall for dairy, and the total metres per size.
Whether the end user specifies 3-A Sanitary Standards, ASME BPE or an in-house dairy standard for surface finish and weld preparation.
Matching electropolished fittings needed: bends, tees, reducers, clamp ferrules and SMS unions.
Delivery point: the dairy site, a RIICO estate fabrication shop, or your own workshop outside Rajasthan.
Documents for handover: EN 10204 3.1 certificate per heat, PMI record for every length, and Ra report for each electropolished lot.

sections.heading: Delivery to Alwar and the NH-48 Belt
paragraphs: Alwar is supplied by road from our Taloja MIDC works; dispatch and transit are confirmed in writing with each quotation. ICD Tughlakabad is the nearest listed container gateway.
